alt: Scanning electron micrographs show a faceted DNA-origami hexagonal-diamond crystal and the ordered pattern resolved on its basal plane.
caption: A detail from the preprint figure: the hexagonal habit and the ordered basal-plane pattern. In-plane order alone does not distinguish hexagonal from cubic diamond — the two differ only in stacking sequence, which the preprint resolves by small-angle X-ray scattering. The complete figure is in the linked preprint.
